hero.frase: Travel begins long before departure, with the curiosity that leads you to seek out places, stories and ways of life different from your own. Because, to me, travelling means getting closer to different realities and coming home with a slightly different perspective on the world.
hero.foto_alt: Laura Atzori, founder of Rotte d’incenso, portrayed in natural light

storia.foto_alt: Laura writing travel notes in a notebook
apertura: My name is Laura. I was born in Sardinia in 1989, and travelling has always been one of the things that makes me feel most alive. It's how I feed my curiosity, discover the world and come home with something new every time.

At some point, I decided to turn this passion into a profession too, by completing a Travel Designer course. It gave me the tools to combine my love of travel with the practical skills needed to plan and organise a trip, from the initial idea right down to the smallest details.
racconto: I'm particularly drawn to warmer countries and tropical regions, to local markets, small villages and places where traditions are still part of everyday life. From Southeast Asia to Nepal, through Morocco and East Africa, especially Kenya and Tanzania, I've always been fascinated by these parts of the world.

I love places that have managed to preserve something of another time, with their authentic atmosphere, slower pace of life and all the little things you discover when you venture beyond the usual tourist trails.

I design trips to destinations all over the world, but if there's one direction my thoughts always return to, it's Asia. This passion was also shaped by the books of Tiziano Terzani, which played an important part in the way I see travel. Someone once jokingly called me one of his “daughters”, and I have to admit it's a compliment I hold very dear.

Above all, he taught me that travelling isn't just about seeing new places. It's about getting to know them, observing the people who live there, discovering their customs and trying to understand realities that may be very different from our own. Without expecting to like everything we find, but always with an open mind and a willingness to be surprised.
storia.citazione: “Travelling is a lesson in humility; it makes you confront the limits of your own understanding.” (Tiziano Terzani, Un indovino mi disse.)
storia.chiusura_citazione: And this is exactly the sense of humility that I bring to my work.
storia.chiusura: I don't create cookie-cutter itineraries or design holidays for those who expect to find everything just as they would at home. I create journeys for people who want to understand a place, experience its everyday life, respect the environment and come home with a genuine, meaningful experience.

come_lavoriamo.sottotitolo: Four steps, from the first wish to departure.

passi.testo: A free introductory call to chat about your vision, your desires, and your perfect way to travel.
Creation of a custom draft itinerary designed just for you, which we can review and adjust together based on your budget and needs.
Finalization of the approved itinerary, booking confirmation, and delivery of all essential travel documents and tips.
Pack your bags and leave your worries behind; I will take care of every detail.

domande.domanda: What does the first consultation include?
domande.risposta: The initial consultation is a complimentary video call lasting around 45 minutes to an hour. We’ll discuss your interests, budget, and expectations to see if my approach aligns with what you’re looking for.
Yes, if you prefer. Alternatively, if you want more flexibility, I can handle the local arrangements while you remain responsible for booking your own international flights.

domande.domanda: How much does the service cost?
domande.risposta: Pricing varies based on your chosen destination, the complexity, and the length of your trip. Following our discovery call, I’ll craft a personalized itinerary complete with a detailed quote.

domande.domanda: How far in advance should I contact you?
domande.risposta: Ideally 8-3 months before departure, to have the widest choice of accommodation and local guides.

domande.domanda: Do you work with large groups?
domande.risposta: I focus mainly on crafting tailor-made journeys for solo travelers, couples, and small groups. For group trips, I work with intimate groups of 6 to 10 people, the perfect size for a truly mindful, attentive, and respectful travel experience.

domande.domanda: Do you offer assistance during the trip?
domande.risposta: Yes. I remain reachable for the whole duration of the journey as a discreet point of contact.
